purpose: Source-authored contracts for custom law profiles that require native status duration mutation semantics. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.
requiredRuntimeProof: status duration write or extension proof
status owner and affected stack correlation proof
